Provider Data Assessment

```{R getData}
#| code-summary: read in data
# === read data from source files (can take a long time)
# source(here("R/getData.R"))
# df <- getData(params$org_id)

# === read from cleaned file generated in pre-render
# df_allData <- read.csv(here("data", "exports", "allData.csv")) %>%
#   filter(source == params$org_id)
# df <- df_allData

# === read from raw file generated in pre-render
df_allData <- read.csv(here("data/exports/allDataRaw.csv")) %>%
  filter(program == params$org_id)
# keep only these columns to reduce RAM usage
 keepCols <- as.vector(c(
   "DEP.Result.Value.Number",
   "Activity.Start.Date.Time",
   "Monitoring.Location.ID",
   "DEP.Analyte.Name",
   "Org.Decimal.Latitude",
   "Org.Decimal.Longitude",
   "program"
 ))
df_allData <- df_allData[,keepCols]
df <- df_allData


df$DEP.Result.Value.Number <- as.numeric(df$DEP.Result.Value.Number)
df$Activity.Start.Date.Time <- as.POSIXct(df$Activity.Start.Date.Time, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
```

```{R create violin plot}
# Load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = DEP.Analyte.Name, y = DEP.Result.Value.Number)) +
  geom_violin(width = 1.2, adjust = 10, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Analyte", y = "Log10(Value)", title = "Violin + Boxplot")

```

```{R create presence table}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

source(here::here("R/presenceTable.R"))

heat_long <- getPresenceHeatmapTable(
  df, 
  analyte_col = "DEP.Analyte.Name", 
  site_col = "Monitoring.Location.ID",
  value_col = "DEP.Result.Value.Number"
)
```

```{R analyte presence table, fig.width=10, fig.height=min(max(6, length(unique(heat_long$Monitoring.Location.ID)) * 0.2),20)}
plotHeatmap(
  heat_long, 
  analyte_col = "DEP.Analyte.Name", 
  site_col = "Monitoring.Location.ID"
)
```


```{R create map }
#| code-summary: create map with unique points

# check for missing lat/lon
if (all(is.na(df$Org.Decimal.Latitude)) || all(is.na(df$Org.Decimal.Longitude))) {
  cat("Cannot make map: All rows have missing latitude or longitude.")
} else {
  library(leaflet)
  library(dplyr)

  # 1. Filter out rows & keep only one per unique lat/lon
  df_unique_locs <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Org.Decimal.Latitude), !is.na(Org.Decimal.Longitude)) %>%
    distinct(Org.Decimal.Latitude, Org.Decimal.Longitude, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # 2. Plot all unique points (no clustering)
  leaflet(df_unique_locs) %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng         = ~Org.Decimal.Longitude,
      lat         = ~Org.Decimal.Latitude,
      radius      = 4,
      color       = "blue",
      fillOpacity = 0.5,
      popup       = ~paste0(
        "Monitoring Location: ", Monitoring.Location.ID
      )
      # clusterOptions removed to show every point at all zoom levels
    )
}
```

```{R prep data through time}
#| code-summary: visualize distribution of points through time
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# Create a dataframe with unique sampling events
sampling_events <- df %>%
  distinct(Activity.Start.Date.Time, Monitoring.Location.ID) %>%
  arrange(Activity.Start.Date.Time)
```

```{R time distribution plot}
#| code-summary: Create time distribution plot
ggplot(sampling_events, aes(x = Activity.Start.Date.Time)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Sampling Events Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Sampling Events"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```

```{R sampling heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=min(max(6, length(unique(heat_long$Monitoring.Location.ID)) * 0.2),20)}
# Create a heatmap of sampling locations over time
# drop rows with missing dates or IDs
sampling_events <- sampling_events %>%
  filter(!is.na(Activity.Start.Date.Time), !is.na(Monitoring.Location.ID))
# if sampling_events is empty, skip this plot
if (nrow(sampling_events) > 0) {
  ggplot(sampling_events, 
          aes(x = Activity.Start.Date.Time, 
              y = Monitoring.Location.ID)) +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(
        title = "Sampling Locations Over Time",
        x = "Date",
        y = "Monitoring.Location.ID"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
} else {
  print("No sampling events with valid dates & IDs")
}
```

```{R print start + end dates}
date_range <- range(df$`Activity.Start.Date.Time`, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Earliest sampling date: ", format(date_range[1], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
  cat("Latest   sampling date: ", format(date_range[2], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
```

## Missing Data
```{R print rows with missing values in critical columns}
# Track which rows we’ve already printed
printed_rows <- integer(0)

invalid_value <- which(is.na(df$DEP.Result.Value.Number) | df$DEP.Result.Value.Number == "")
print(glue("{length(invalid_value)} Invalid 'value's"))
DT::datatable(df[invalid_value, ])
printed_rows <- c(printed_rows, invalid_value)

invalid_value <- which(is.na(df$Monitoring.Location.ID) | df$Monitoring.Location.ID == "")
print(glue("{length(invalid_value)} Invalid 'site's"))
DT::datatable(df[invalid_value, ])
printed_rows <- c(printed_rows, invalid_value)


invalid_units <- which((is.na(df$units) | df$units == "") & !(seq_len(nrow(df)) %in% printed_rows))
print(glue("{length(invalid_units)} Invalid 'units' (excluding already printed)"))
DT::datatable(df[invalid_units, ])
printed_rows <- c(printed_rows, invalid_units)

invalid_latlon <- which((
  is.na(df$Org.Decimal.Latitude) | df$Org.Decimal.Latitude == "" |
  is.na(df$Org.Decimal.Longitude) | df$Org.Decimal.Longitude == ""
) & !(seq_len(nrow(df)) %in% printed_rows))
print(glue("{length(invalid_latlon)} Invalid spatial coordinates (excluding already printed)"))
DT::datatable(df[invalid_latlon, ])
printed_rows <- c(printed_rows, invalid_latlon)

```
